scope.method: Read pinned Git objects through previously known workflow/stage indexes; followed the identified MEM-1 and CTRL-1 originals only after discovery.
scope.indexed_raw_hash_note: The indexed originals below have exact Git blob identities. Their raw SHA256/size fields are retained historical manifest declarations, not new archive-content validation or replay.

summary.decision_boundary: Historical MEM shared-model NoUpdate and CTRL research Candidate/NoUpdate belong to their original synthetic protocols. This inventory does not execute or decide a real A-to-training-to-independent-B-to-C protocol on 445.
summary.eligible_reuse: Historical mechanism evidence, strong-baseline comparisons, negative results, accounting limits and preserved failure/recovery references under their original identities.

source_and_candidate_identity.scope: three-crate source projection and synthetic reference; not full workspace or production
source_and_candidate_identity.execution_identity_note: The retained pilot binds an upstream commit, a transformed three-crate source projection, source-file SHA256 values and the binary. Neither the upstream commit nor the historically observed publication head is asserted to be the exact full executed Git tree.

sample_definition.units: Five synthetic stream seeds; not real source clusters or pretrained-model repeats.
sample_definition.curriculum: A1=96 observations, B=104, A2=40; predict-then-update online scores and read-only probes.
sample_definition.namespace_limit: B is a training/interference stream and A2 returns to A. These names do not establish the user's held-out evaluation B and later real task C.

baseline_and_observed_result.strongest_and_cheapest_arm: Exact-key current-fact RAG in this synthetic task; not an LLM RAG system.
baseline_and_observed_result.replacement_basis: Original report explicitly finds no basis for replacing RAG.
baseline_and_observed_result.rehearsal_limit: Uniform versus no replay adds 128 updates; the report does not call that a special consolidation advantage.
baseline_and_observed_result.selector_limit: Actual production HNMF/current-owner integration was not performed. This is not the requested real-task experiment with a fixed production selector.

cost_scope.recorded: Kernel multiplications, child/Python CPU, descriptive debug-harness wall time, owner-call counts, payload/update/state counters.
explicit_limits: owner calls have no complete event-level ledger
retained pool snapshots establish only a lower bound on the full peak
kernel counts exclude hashing/IPC; full physical cost is not reconstructed
cost_scope.current_results_amendment: Current RESULTS adds retained-binary-byte requirements and the explicit PARTIAL-cost/authentication limit; historical measurements and HOLD are unchanged.

current_results.scope: The appended verification paragraph explicitly retains PARTIAL cost accounting and unchanged historical HOLD.

verifier.scope: Returned cost_audit object: status=PARTIAL, complete_cost_verified=False, with the three listed accounting limitations.

old_capability_and_recovery.observed: Synthetic A-stable retention before/after B and return, excluding replaced/revoked/out-of-scope records as declared.
old_capability_and_recovery.limit: Python owner, RNG and teacher remain alive; complete owner crash recovery and uninterrupted paired trajectories were not tested.

why_not_445_P1_gain: No independently sourced real document/history clusters or independent real future B/C panel

sample_definition.source_scope: Known finite/POMDP transition model, not real document/tool/GUI content outcomes.
sample_definition.namespace_limit: A/B/C/D are distinct objective profiles, not the user's learning-chain A/B/C phases.

baseline_and_observed_result.strongest_mean_value: Fixed-threshold hybrid has the highest mean value in all four profiles.
baseline_and_observed_result.selection_limit: Research Candidate/NoUpdate does not grant native owner adoption.

cost_scope.declared_cost: Per-call simulation credits and simulated time under the fixed objective profile.
cost_scope.measured_scope: Worker CPU includes teacher work, training, failed/partial epochs and checkpoint serialization; shared roster, parent supervision and evaluation have separate scopes.
